question: Identify the top 10 Citibike stations by highest proportion of group rides, defined as trips starting and ending at the same station where multiple riders departed/arrived within the same 2-minute time window. Calculate the proportion as the number of trips that are part of a group divided by the total number of trips ending at that station.
sql:
-- Final query: top 10 stations by proportion of group rides
WITH round_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_id,
        end_station_id,
        starttime,
        DATE(starttime) as trip_date,
        EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) as hour_val,
        MOD(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM CAST(starttime AS DATETIME)), 2) as minute_mod,
        bikeid
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
window_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_id,
        trip_date,
        hour_val,
        minute_mod,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM round_trips
    GROUP BY start_station_id, trip_date, hour_val, minute_mod
),
group_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        rt.end_station_id,
        rt.bikeid
    FROM round_trips rt
    JOIN window_counts wc 
        ON rt.start_station_id = wc.start_station_id
        AND rt.trip_date = wc.trip_date
        AND rt.hour_val = wc.hour_val
        AND rt.minute_mod = wc.minute_mod
    WHERE wc.cnt >= 2
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        end_station_id,
        COUNT(*) as group_trip_count
    FROM group_trips
    GROUP BY end_station_id
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        end_station_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_trips_ending
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id
)
SELECT 
    s.name as station_name,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(gc.group_trip_count, tc.total_trips_ending) as proportion_of_group_rides
FROM total_counts tc
JOIN group_counts gc ON tc.end_station_id = gc.end_station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` s
    ON CAST(tc.end_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
WHERE gc.group_trip_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY proportion_of_group_rides DESC
LIMIT 10
